results.question: Find portfolios that have holdings in more than 5 different sectors and show their diversification metrics
results.expected_sql: WITH portfolio_sector_count AS (SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sec.sector_id) as sector_count FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id WHERE s.asset_type = 'Stock' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sec.sector_id) > 5), portfolio_holdings_count AS (SELECT p.portfolio_id, COUNT(h.holding_id) as total_holdings FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id) SELECT psc.portfolio_name, psc.sector_count, phc.total_holdings, ROUND(CAST(psc.sector_count AS REAL) / phc.total_holdings, 3) as diversification_ratio FROM portfolio_sector_count psc JOIN portfolio_holdings_count phc ON psc.portfolio_id = phc.portfolio_id ORDER BY diversification_ratio DESC;
results.actual_sql: WITH portfolio_sector_count AS (SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sec.sector_id) as sector_count FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id WHERE s.asset_type = 'Stock' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sec.sector_id) > 5), portfolio_holdings_count AS (SELECT p.portfolio_id, COUNT(h.holding_id) as total_holdings FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id) SELECT psc.portfolio_name, psc.sector_count, phc.total_holdings, ROUND(CAST(psc.sector_count AS REAL) / phc.total_holdings, 3) as diversification_ratio FROM portfolio_sector_count psc JOIN portfolio_holdings_count phc ON psc.portfolio_id = phc.portfolio_id ORDER BY diversification_ratio DESC;
